k: Quarry stone that soaked up the violet seam beneath it, and got up.
src: 'Quarry stone that soaked up the violet seam beneath it, and got up.'

k: Mender, Arcanist, Ranger, Cantor, Pugilist. "Same old woman. Different tools."
src: 'Mender, Arcanist, Ranger, Cantor, Pugilist. "Same old woman. Different tools."'

k: Her bark splits wide open. A hundred voices weep at once!
src: 'Her bark splits wide open. A hundred voices weep at once!'

k: The Hollow Mother draws every voice in the wold into her branches...
src: 'The Hollow Mother draws every voice in the wold into her branches...'

k: Old Strawman bursts into violet flame!
Old Strawman flaps its sleeves. Crows pour out of its coat!
src: 'Old Strawman flaps its sleeves. Crows pour out of its coat!'

k: Violet dust gathers in Old Strawman's stitched grin...
src: 'Violet dust gathers in Old Strawman\'s stitched grin...'

k: Harbor town of the Gale Coast. Sailors, smugglers, and the Salt & Lantern.
src: 'Harbor town of the Gale Coast. Sailors, smugglers, and the Salt & Lantern.'

k: An ancient forest where the trees speak with the voices of the dead.
src: 'An ancient forest where the trees speak with the voices of the dead.'

k: A farming village of beehives and autumn fields. Home of the Crestless Sage.
src: 'A farming village of beehives and autumn fields. Home of the Crestless Sage.'

k: A bronze bell-hammer worn smooth by forty years of noons. Its name, scratched on the handle, is GLORIA.
src: 'A bronze bell-hammer worn smooth by forty years of noons. Its name, scratched on the handle, is GLORIA.'

k: A loose page from the Chronicle of the Long Night. Someone has inked over certain words. Thoroughly.
src: 'A loose page from the Chronicle of the Long Night. Someone has inked over certain words. Thoroughly.'

k: A large ginger cat, currently being carried by Sable. He is tolerating this.
src: 'A large ginger cat, currently being carried by Sable. He is tolerating this.'

k: Immune to Sleep and Silence. Beeswax, forty years of bells, and a little spite.
src: 'Immune to Sleep and Silence. Beeswax, forty years of bells, and a little spite.'

k: DEF +5, RES +5, HP +5%. Sir Aldous Venn's ring. Too big for any finger but his.
src: 'DEF +5, RES +5, HP +5%. Sir Aldous Venn\'s ring. Too big for any finger but his.'

k: RES +5, Afterglow gain +15%. A handbell from the first carillon of Aurenne. It rings true.
src: 'RES +5, Afterglow gain +15%. A handbell from the first carillon of Aurenne. It rings true.'

k: The great bell tolls through bone.
The Gloam pulls at the edges of you.
src: 'The Gloam pulls at the edges of you.'

k: The rooks of St. Aurel's have heard the bells every hour of their lives. It has not improved their mood.
src: 'The rooks of St. Aurel\'s have heard the bells every hour of their lives. It has not improved their mood.'

k: Carved to spit rainwater off the roofs. Something down in the drains taught it to spit other things.
src: 'Carved to spit rainwater off the roofs. Something down in the drains taught it to spit other things.'

k: Grew fat on what the city flushes away. Is not grateful.
src: 'Grew fat on what the city flushes away. Is not grateful.'

k: It drinks until it is round, then keeps drinking out of habit.
src: 'It drinks until it is round, then keeps drinking out of habit.'

k: Lives on the Choir's candle-ends. Its dust smells like a cathedral and puts you to sleep like a sermon.
src: 'Lives on the Choir\'s candle-ends. Its dust smells like a cathedral and puts you to sleep like a sermon.'

k: All bone and appetite. It still wags, which is worse.
src: 'All bone and appetite. It still wags, which is worse.'

k: Aurenne's old city watch. Still guarding the gate. The gate is gone.
src: 'Aurenne\'s old city watch. Still guarding the gate. The gate is gone.'

k: A candle lit for the dead, forty years ago. Nobody blew it out.
src: 'A candle lit for the dead, forty years ago. Nobody blew it out.'

k: A Sister of Small Mercies. She sings the Dawnsong. Something is wrong with the way she sings it.
src: 'A Sister of Small Mercies. She sings the Dawnsong. Something is wrong with the way she sings it.'

k: Mercy gave it a memory to hold. It dropped it.
src: 'Mercy gave it a memory to hold. It dropped it.'

k: Several people, once. Mercy's notes call it "an economy of scale."
src: 'Several people, once. Mercy\'s notes call it "an economy of scale."'

k: Wooden rules, first to yield. Nobody has ever told a squire that wooden swords still hurt.
src: 'Wooden rules, first to yield. Nobody has ever told a squire that wooden swords still hurt.'

k: The bell-founders of old Aurenne were buried beside their furnace. One of them got up to finish a job.
src: 'The bell-founders of old Aurenne were buried beside their furnace. One of them got up to finish a job.'

k: The City of Bells. Seat of the Choir, home of the Grand Lantern.
src: 'The City of Bells. Seat of the Choir, home of the Grand Lantern.'

k: Lift-glass from the Glass Caverns. It hums when you hold it to the sun — and when you hold it near the tuning forks.
src: 'Lift-glass from the Glass Caverns. It hums when you hold it to the sun — and when you hold it near the tuning forks.'

k: The Dawnsong in Brother Halvard's cramped hand. One note is circled twice. Beside it: REFLECTION?
src: 'The Dawnsong in Brother Halvard\'s cramped hand. One note is circled twice. Beside it: REFLECTION?'

k: An iron key, warm from Halvard's hand.
src: 'An iron key, warm from Halvard\'s hand.'

k: The color of the dunes at noon. You find out it is there when it finds out you are.
src: 'The color of the dunes at noon. You find out it is there when it finds out you are.'

k: A sand wyrm hatchling: the length of a man and all appetite. Its mother is never far.
src: 'A sand wyrm hatchling: the length of a man and all appetite. Its mother is never far.'

k: A shimmer of heat that decided to stay. Drinks fire. Fears the dark.
src: 'A shimmer of heat that decided to stay. Drinks fire. Fears the dark.'

k: It is patient. In the Sunscar, patience always eats.
src: 'It is patient. In the Sunscar, patience always eats.'

k: Takes your water first. Then your boots. Then, if you complain, you.
src: 'Takes your water first. Then your boots. Then, if you complain, you.'

k: Throws sand, stones and insults, all with remarkable accuracy.
src: 'Throws sand, stones and insults, all with remarkable accuracy.'

k: It wears the shape of what you want most. Up close it is only heat and hunger.
src: 'It wears the shape of what you want most. Up close it is only heat and hunger.'

k: A sand wyrm in its prime: forty feet of hunger that swims the dunes like open sea.
src: 'A sand wyrm in its prime: forty feet of hunger that swims the dunes like open sea.'

k: Raider-king of the southern dunes. Laughs like a jackal. Fights like three of them.
src: 'Raider-king of the southern dunes. Laughs like a jackal. Fights like three of them.'

k: Its shell is saltglass. It chimes when it walks, which is the only mercy it offers.
src: 'Its shell is saltglass. It chimes when it walks, which is the only mercy it offers.'

k: Wings thin enough to throw rainbows. It throws them in your eyes.
src: 'Wings thin enough to throw rainbows. It throws them in your eyes.'

k: The caverns grow them like geodes. Nobody knows what wakes them. Something does.
src: 'The caverns grow them like geodes. Nobody knows what wakes them. Something does.'

k: Spins its webs from molten sand. They set like glass, and so do you.
src: 'Spins its webs from molten sand. They set like glass, and so do you.'

k: The Queen's children. Half-grown and wholly furious.
src: 'The Queen\'s children. Half-grown and wholly furious.'

k: She has eaten caravans whole. Her scales are saltglass; her song is the sound of the desert breaking.
src: 'She has eaten caravans whole. Her scales are saltglass; her song is the sound of the desert breaking.'
